segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Who do I have on the line?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi Maya, this is Kevin Roth at Parkline Manufacturing. I’m calling about our June invoice. It looks like one of the seat bundles is on there twice.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, yeah, I can take a look. Do you have the invoice number handy?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, invoice 784216, dated June 1. The total is showing $3,840, but it should be $2,880. The 25-seat operations bundle at $960 is listed two times.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. Give me just a second while I pull that up in the billing tool. Okay, I see your account, Parkline Manufacturing, monthly subscription, 75 total seats. And yeah, I’m seeing two line items both labeled operations bundle, 25 seats, June 1 through June 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right, and we didn’t add seats. We’ve had the same 75 since March. Our AP team is asking if they should short-pay it or wait for a corrected invoice.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I wouldn’t recommend short-paying yet. I’m checking the account record in the admin console, and it does show only three 25-seat bundles active, not four. So the subscription setup looks normal, but the invoice picked up an extra line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We need to close this by Friday if possible. Payment run is on June 7.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Understood. I’m going to open a billing review ticket and attach the invoice detail. The ticket number is 319842. I’ll ask our billing team to confirm whether they can void and reissue the invoice or issue a credit for the duplicate $960.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you email me that ticket number and the plan? I just need something to send back to AP.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I’ll send that to the email we have for you, kevin.roth@parklinemfg.com, in the next few minutes. I don’t want to promise the corrected invoice while we’re on the call, but I’ll follow up as soon as billing confirms the next step.
